question: When was Keble College, Oxford founded? Answer in one sentence with a citation.
lines: Keble College is one of the colleges of the University of Oxford.
It stands on Parks Road, opposite the University Parks.
Keble College, Oxford was founded in 1870.
It is named after John Keble, a leader of the Oxford Movement.
Its red-brick chapel and buildings were designed by William Butterfield.
